title: [P0] Implement native Yggdrasil AddrForKey in Python
description:
Spec updated in 06-security.md §8.7 to use native Yggdrasil algorithm.

## Algorithm (from yggdrasil-go)
```
inverted = NOT(pubkey)
ones = count_leading_ones(inverted)
skip terminating 0-bit
remaining = next 112 bits
addr = [0x02] || [ones] || remaining[0:14]
IID = addr[8:16]
```

## Files to update
- `python/src/lichen/crypto/identity.py`: `_pubkey_to_iid()`, `yggdrasil_address()`
- `python/src/lichen/ipv6/addr.py`: `pubkey_to_iid()`, `yggdrasil_address_from_pubkey()`
- `python/tests/crypto/test_identity.py`: Update VECTORS with native Yggdrasil IIDs

## Test vector (upstream)
pubkey: bdbacfd82240de3dcd123924cbb55256fb8dab08aa98e305528ab84f419e6efb
addr:   0200848a604fbb7e438465db8db66895
IID:    438465db8db66895

## Key change
IID is NO LONGER SHA-256(pubkey)[0:8]. It's the lower 8 bytes of the Yggdrasil address (pure bit manipulation, no hash).
close_reason: Native Yggdrasil AddrForKey implemented in crypto/identity.py and ipv6/addr.py. All 345 tests pass.
